title: The State of Data Curation at NeurIPS: An Assessment of Dataset Development Practices in the Datasets and Benchmarks Track

bias_targets.methodology: Manual audit of dataset documentation across 60 NeurIPS datasets using a data curation rubric to evaluate whether dataset creators explicitly reflect on biases introduced by data workers during problem formulation, data synthesis, and dataset creation.

Manual audit of dataset documentation across 60 NeurIPS datasets using a data curation rubric to evaluate whether dataset creators reflect on how sampling procedures, representativeness, and selected data sources might perpetuate existing social and historical biases.
